explanation:
Conjectured 12-variable, 33-clause UNSAT counterexample to H2 under the exact full E-MRA and plain MRA semantics with order 1..12 (conjecture pending independent verification).

Construction: Start from the verified 12-variable, 32-clause SAT fixture—whose 25-clause binary implication SCC over layers A={3,4}, B={5,6,7}, C={8,9,10}, D={11,12} forces 3..12 to be mutually equivalent—and add the single binary clause [-11, -12].

UNSAT proof: The binary SCC forces all variables 3..12 to share one truth value. Clause [-11, -12] forbids all-True, so 3..12 must all be False. Then [-1, 3, 4] forces 1=False, [1, 2, 5] forces 2=True, and [1, -2, 8] forces 2=False, a contradiction.

Plain MRA (order 1..12): Root is width 3 (peak 1). Branching on 1 yields width<=2 on both sides: 1=True leaves binary clauses plus [3,4]; 1=False leaves binary clauses plus [2,5..7] and [-2,8..10]. Both terminate immediately via exact 2SAT (UNSAT), giving plain MRA peak = 1.

Full E-MRA (order 1..12):
- Root: Variable 1 has (p,n)=(6,1), p*n=6 <= 7, so ELIM eliminates 1, replacing 7 clauses with 6 width-4 resolvents [2,3,4,5..7] and [-2,3,4,8..10] (32 clauses). Every remaining variable then has p*n > p+n with no net clause reduction (including 11,12 with (p,n)=(3,3) yielding 9 non-subsumed resolvents, and 3,4 with (p,n)=(8,3) yielding 18 resolvents after subsumption). Root is STUCK (frontier 1).
- Branch on 1: Missing, state unchanged (frontier 1).
- Branch on 2: 2=True yields G1 (core + [-11,-12] + [3,4,8..10], 29 clauses); 2=False yields G2 (core + [-11,-12] + [3,4,5..7], 29 clauses). Both are width 3 and ELIM-stuck (in G2, eliminating 3 or 4 removes 8 clauses and leaves 9 after subsumption; in both, 11 and 12 remove 6 and add 9). Neither syntactically subsumes the other, so both survive pruning, giving E-MRA peak = 2 > 1.
- Branch on 3: 3=True derives UNSAT by UP via [-11,-12]; 3=False drops to width 2 (2SAT UNSAT).

Scalable family: For k>=1, use 1 trigger t, k branch variables b_1..b_k, a binary SCC with layers A(2), L_{1,+}(3), L_{1,-}(3), ..., L_{k,-}(3), D(2), plus [-d1,-d2], [-t,a1,a2], and [t,b_i,L_{i,+}], [t,-b_i,L_{i,-}] (7k+5 variables, 24k+9 clauses; k=1 is this fixture). Under order t, b_1..b_k, core, plain MRA stays at peak 1 while full E-MRA is conjectured to reach 2^k syntactically incomparable ELIM-stuck UNSAT states before branching on A. This observation is not an asymptotic proof. Binary-SCC recognition or UP-entailment pruning could collapse these states but are not part of the tested E-MRA semantics.
